python - <<'PY'
import operator
import semver
v = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 4, 5)
assert tuple(v) == (1, 2, 3, '4', '5')
for name in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
    try:
        setattr(v, name, 'changed')
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name)
    try:
        delattr(v, name)
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name)
for op in (operator.eq, operator.ne, operator.lt, operator.le, operator.gt, operator.ge):
    for other in [(1, 2, 3), (1, 2, 3, '4'), (2, 0, 0), tuple(v)]:
        assert op(v, other) == op(v, semver.VersionInfo(*other))
        assert op(other, v) == op(semver.VersionInfo(*other), v)
    for other in ('1.2.3', 123):
        assert getattr(v, '__%s__' % op.__name__)(other) is NotImplemented
        if op not in (operator.eq, operator.ne):
            try:
                op(v, other)
            except TypeError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError('unsupported comparison')
for version in ('1.2.3', '1.2.3-rc.9+build.009', '1.2.3-alpha'):
    original = semver.VersionInfo.parse(version)
    for part in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
        new = getattr(original, 'bump_' + part)()
        assert isinstance(new, semver.VersionInfo)
        assert str(new) == getattr(semver, 'bump_' + part)(version)
        assert str(original) == version
    assert original.replace() is not original
assert semver.replace('1.2.3-rc.1+build.4', major='2', prerelease=None) == '2.2.3+build.4'
try:
    v.replace(unknown=1)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('unknown keyword')
parser = semver.createparser()
assert parser.prog == 'pysemver'
assert semver.process(parser.parse_args(['compare', '1.2.3', '2.0.0'])) == -1
assert semver.process(parser.parse_args(['bump', 'major', '1.2.3'])) == '2.0.0'
assert semver.process(parser.parse_args(['check', '1.2.3'])) is None
print('Targeted API checks passed')
